evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular carilage and osteophytes of left knee and mild subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing of articular carilage and osteophytes of left knee and mild subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.PF OA: mild subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting osteoarthritis with grade 4 chondromalacia.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion with internal septums in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles and downward extention, in favor of Baker's cyst
evidence.Contusion: mild subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting osteoarthritis
